description: This Java source file defines the class VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter, which extends AbstractVertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter and implements an HTTP protocol adapter for the Eclipse Hono project using Vert.x. It sets up routes for telemetry, event, and command response endpoints, handles authentication, and manages CORS headers.

classes.name: VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A Vert.x based HTTP protocol adapter for Eclipse Hono, handles routing, authentication, and message uploads.

methods.name: setUsernamePasswordAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider for device authentication using username and password.

methods.name: setClientCertAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider for device authentication based on client certificates.

methods.name: setTenantObjectWithAuthIdProvider
methods.description: Sets the provider that determines tenant and auth ID from requests.

methods.name: getTenantTraceSamplingHandler
methods.description: Returns the handler for tenant trace sampling.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the protocol adapter type name, 'http'.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Sets up HTTP routes for telemetry, event, and command responses based on configuration.

methods.name: addTelemetryApiRoutes
methods.description: Configures routes related to telemetry data, including CORS support and authentication checks.

methods.name: addEventApiRoutes
methods.description: Configures routes related to event data, including CORS support and authentication checks.

methods.name: addCommandResponseRoutes
methods.description: Configures routes for command response messages, handling CORS and authorization.

methods.name: getTenantParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'tenant' path parameter from the request context.

methods.name: getDeviceIdParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'device_id' path parameter from the request context.

methods.name: getCommandRequestIdParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'cmd_req_id' path parameter from the request context.

methods.name: getCommandResponseStatusParam
methods.description: Retrieves the command response status from the request context.

methods.name: handle401
methods.description: Handles unauthorized responses by setting HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate header.

methods.name: handlePostTelemetry
methods.description: Handles POST telemetry requests, authenticates device, and uploads telemetry data.

methods.name: handlePostEvent
methods.description: Handles POST event requests, authenticates device, and uploads event data.

methods.name: handlePostCommandResponse
methods.description: Handles POST command response requests, authenticates device, and uploads command response data.

methods.name: assertTenant
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated device's tenant matches the request's tenant parameter.
